def find_permutation(n, k):
    permutation = list(range(1, n + 1))
    for i in range(1, n):
        if k == 0:
            break
        if i < n - i:
            permutation[i], permutation[n - i - 1] = permutation[n - i - 1], permutation[i]
            k -= 1
    return permutation

n, k = map(int, input().split())

permutation = find_permutation(n, k)
